source.title: Feralas Mission VII: Recover Moonglow Dragonegg
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Oneiros. Retrieve a Moonglow Dragonegg and deliver it to me.
source.objective: Recover a Moonglow Dragonegg in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion from the gazebo at Oneiros and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
